# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Jul 14, 2026)
## OVERVIEW
Today's development focused on enhancing deployment tools, fixing critical bugs in dispute game components, and improving documentation for node operators. Significant progress was also made in CI/CD pipelines and Kona driver performance.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Deployment Tooling and L1 Address Prediction
A new feature was added to bootstrap the `prepare` command and predict L1 addresses within the `op-deployer` tool. This enhancement streamlines the deployment process by allowing for the prediction of L1 addresses, which is crucial for L2 genesis configuration.
- [#21560](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21560)

### Dispute Game Bug Fixes
Several critical bugs related to the dispute game components were addressed. This includes fixing intermittent "Text file busy" build flakes in Docker, enabling the `op-proposer` to scan common game metadata across different game types, and ensuring `op-challenger` uses the correct VM configuration for state conversion.
- [#21734](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21734)
- [#21741](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21741)
- [#21739](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21739)

### Documentation and Node Operator Guidance
Extensive updates were made to the documentation, providing clearer guidance for node operators. This includes documenting supported `op-reth` pruning options, warning against `--minimal` pruning, and adding guidelines for concise PR descriptions. Social thumbnail styling was also updated, and the transaction statuses page was relabeled as a reference.
- [#21672](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21672)
- [#21735](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21735)
- [#21732](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21732)
- [#21769](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21769)

### CI/CD and Performance Improvements
Significant work was done on CI/CD, including adding parallel Apko image builds and implementing retries for `go mod download` and `go install` in Docker builds to improve reliability. The Kona driver also saw a performance improvement by decoding only the L1-info deposit when computing `L2BlockInfo`.
- [#21557](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21557)
- [#21736](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21736)
- [#21737](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21737)

## CLOSED ISSUES

### RPC Binding Default and Security
The issue regarding defaulting RPC binding to `127.0.0.1` instead of `0.0.0.0` was closed as not planned. The decision was based on the fact that Docker images, our default release artifacts, require `0.0.0.0` for external reachability, and privileged APIs are already opt-in, mitigating accidental public exposure.
- [#16487](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/16487)

### Deployment and L1 Address Prediction
The issue tracking the prediction of L1 addresses via dry-run for the `op-deployer` was closed, indicating the successful implementation of this feature.
- [#20908](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20908)

### Node Pruning and EL Sync Issues
The issue concerning `op-node` EL sync failures with `--minimal` pruned nodes was closed. The resolution involved documenting supported `op-reth` pruning configurations and clarifying that block bodies must not be pruned for OP Stack nodes.
- [#21465](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21465)

### Permissioned Game Prestate Handling
The problem where `op-challenger` required a `cannon-prestate` even for permissioned games configured with `--prestates-url` was resolved.
- [#21470](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21470)

## NEW ISSUES

### Kona SP1 Performance and Security
New issues highlight concerns about the performance of EIP-2537 precompiles in `kona-sp1` due to unaccelerated `arkworks` and the need to re-add a Kona registry depset test for interop-staging networks.
- [#21767](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21767)
- [#21760](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21760)

### Op-Geth Decoupling and Script Engine Transition
A series of issues were opened as part of the `op-geth` decoupling effort, focusing on replacing `op-chain-ops/script`'s EVM with a Rust script engine, retiring the in-process `op-geth` L2 EL in tests, owning the log layer, and deleting stale fork checker tools.
- [#21743](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21743)
